title: Ethir Kaatru
desc: A dubious financial company uses an unemployed youth as a scapegoat to conceal their fraudulent business. However, his suspicious death compels a journalist to expose the firm's deceptive practices.

title: Annan Ennada Thambi Ennada
desc: A man continually disrespects women, much to the annoyance of his brother. Frustrated by his behaviour, his brother decides to teach him a lesson.

title: Thangathin Thangam
desc: A young village leader falls in love with a girl assuming that she is a villager. However, his life takes a turn when he comes to know that she is from a very rich family and a friend of his enemy.

title: Vaidehi Kathirunthal
desc: Vaidehi, a widow and Vellaisamy, a homeless man, undergo a drastic turn in their lives as they join forces to save a young couple from the fury of the villagers.

title: Murattu Kaalai
desc: Kaalaiyan is a landlord who lives a humble life with his brothers despite his wealth. However, a greedy man from a neighbouring village plots to take over his land.
